questions.prompt: What is the most direct learning goal for this lesson?
options: Skip type checking and accept any result.
Replace a focused example with unrelated code.
The main goal is to apply conformance in a type declaration in a small Swift example and verify the result.
Use protocol conformance only for visual styling.
questions.answer_key: The main goal is to apply conformance in a type declaration in a small Swift example and verify the result.
questions.explanation: Protocol Conformance is best learned through a small, verifiable example. A protocol expresses a behavioral contract. Conformance lets code depend on capabilities instead of coupling directly to one concrete implementation.

questions.prompt: Which practice supports maintainable Swift code?
options: Use the newest API without checking target compatibility.
Use documented Swift semantics, explicit data flow and a test for a meaningful edge case.
Force all values through unsafe operations.
Ignore ownership and errors when an example works once.
questions.answer_key: Use documented Swift semantics, explicit data flow and a test for a meaningful edge case.
questions.explanation: Protocol Conformance is best learned through a small, verifiable example. A protocol expresses a behavioral contract. Conformance lets code depend on capabilities instead of coupling directly to one concrete implementation.

questions.prompt: What is the strongest verification step for a code example?
options: Compile/run in the intended environment and confirm behavior against the versioned reference.
Rely on a source screenshot without running or inspecting it.
Assume the browser preview compiled Swift successfully.
Test only the happy path and skip environment details.
questions.answer_key: Compile/run in the intended environment and confirm behavior against the versioned reference.
questions.explanation: Protocol Conformance is best learned through a small, verifiable example. A protocol expresses a behavioral contract. Conformance lets code depend on capabilities instead of coupling directly to one concrete implementation.
